# Stitch Export

> Stitch Export is a free, open-source Chrome extension for Google Stitch that exports every project — screens, images, design systems and the full chat history — to ZIP archives and LLM-ready JSON (Claude, ChatGPT), locally in your browser.

## What it does

- Export All Projects: one ZIP with every Google Stitch project (final HTML screens, image screens at original resolution, per-turn screen history, DESIGN.md design systems, chat.json, conversation in Claude / OpenAI / Custom format).
- Export This Project (ZIP): the same for one project, plus a full-size screenshot of every HTML screen.
- Export Conversation: the chat as JSON only.
- Runs locally in the browser against Stitch's own endpoints; no servers, analytics or tracking. MIT licensed.

## Install

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/stitch-export/epmhicnoeiapmnobjhlliadbafbkdmag
- Or clone the repo and "Load unpacked" at chrome://extensions (no build step).
